analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. Head lines 1561-1569 add a paragraph on tokenizer byte-fallback (`<0xHH>`) decoding: LocalTokenizerBridge.decode releases a trailing run itself, and DetokenizerV2 holds back U+FFFD so segment restart cannot split a character. No executable source, wire protocol, authorization, attestation, encryption, key handling, cache storage or billing control is modified. The two supplied units are base-text excerpts (lines 4495-5336) of unchanged surrounding documentation; the changed range sits in a different part of the file, so I reviewed the base text only as context. None of the changed text weakens a documented threat-model assumption or mitigation. The described tokenizer decode fix concerns output correctness, not confidentiality (A-001) or the T-008 encryption-failure path. Integration gap: the actual code change in LocalTokenizerLoader.swift is not supplied here, so I cannot confirm it introduces no logging or exposure of decoded text. No finding is raised, since there is no evidence of one. The cache-related passages in the supplied base text (prefix-cache/T-041) are unchanged.
